wholePhysicalScope: The exact mapped 12-corner standing cathedral exterior, near-straight 26.46 m west front and eastern sanctuary projection, with approximate component sections from the three verified archived cathedral views.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the west portico and towers, nave, dome and sanctuary. Near levels refine the open arches, columns, fenestration and roof finials.
limitations: Main west facade proportions are reconstructed from the archive photographs. Side and rear elevations, the precise central drum and dome, restoration-era finish and individual statuary are exterior estimates.
The model covers the cathedral and entry sequence. The separately mapped museum, graves and compound buildings are outside its scope.
